messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

- As of 2026-06-08, Farah is back on the Team Dune on-call rotation as the primary on-call. [valid 2026-06-08 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-06-08]

- On the 2026-06-08 rotation day, Tomasz Nowak handed the Team Dune pager to Farah. [valid 2026-06-08 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-06-08]

    earlier: The billing service lives with Team Boreal as of the 2025-03-17 handover. [valid 2025-03-17 to 2026-05-26; recorded by handover/2025-03-17-billing-api]
    earlier: The billing service lives with Team Atlas. [valid 2025-01-08 to 2025-03-17; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-08]
- On 2026-05-25, Team Atlas observed that the webhook dispatcher's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change. [valid 2026-05-25 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-05-25-2]
- The INC-2026-009 follow-up decision on 2026-05-08 decided that the scheduler leader lease will be shortened to ten seconds, because two leaders ran the nightly jobs twice in INC-2026-009. [decision; valid 2026-05-08 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-009]
- The INC-2026-009 review found that the scheduler ran the nightly jobs twice because two leaders were elected during a network partition. [valid 2026-05-08 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-009]
- INC-2026-009 was an incident in which the scheduler ran the nightly jobs twice on 2026-05-03. [valid 2026-05-08 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-009]
- As of 2026-05-04, Team Boreal still owns the catalog service. [valid 2026-05-04 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-05-04]
- On 2026-05-04, Team Boreal decided that the event bus will retain messages for seven days because replaying a full week has covered every incident recovery so far. [decision; valid 2026-05-04 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-05-04]
- Farah is off the Team Dune on-call rotation as of 2026-04-13; as of 2026-02-04 the Team Dune pager for that cycle was carried by Tomasz Nowak. [valid 2026-04-13 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-04-13]
    earlier: Farah is on the Team Dune on-call rotation; as of 2026-02-04 the pager for this cycle is carried by Tomasz Nowak. [valid 2026-02-04 to 2026-04-13; recorded by standup/dune/2026-02-04]
    earlier: As of 2025-12-15, Farah is back on the Team Dune on-call rotation, carrying the pager for this cycle. [valid 2025-12-15 to 2026-02-04; recorded by standup/dune/2025-12-15]
    earlier: As of 2025-10-27, Tomasz Nowak is back on the Team Dune on-call rotation, carrying the pager for this cycle. [valid 2025-10-27 to 2025-12-15; recorded by standup/dune/2025-10-27]
    earlier: As of 2025-09-22, Tomasz Nowak is off the Team Dune on-call rotation, after holding the pager since 2025-07-30. [valid 2025-09-22 to 2025-10-27; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-22]
    earlier: As of 2025-07-30, Tomasz Nowak is on call for Team Dune this cycle, having received the pager from Farah. [valid 2025-07-30 to 2025-09-22; recorded by standup/dune/2025-07-30]
    earlier: As of 2025-07-17, Farah is on call for Team Dune this cycle. [valid 2025-07-17 to 2025-07-30; recorded by standup/dune/2025-07-17]
- On 2026-03-31, the Ember team observed that the feature-flags service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy, and flagged it since the feature-flags service is not the Ember team's service. [valid 2026-03-31 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-03-31]
- On 2026-03-19, the Ember team observed that the scheduler's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-03-19 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-03-19-2]
- As of 2026-03-12, Lena is the contact to page for anything related to Team Boreal. [valid 2026-03-12 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-03-12]
- The webhook dispatcher's deploy window is on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2026-03-10 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-03-10-2]
- On 2026-03-10, Team Dune observed that after Tuesday's deploy, the reporting service's p99 latency doubled. [valid 2026-03-10 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-03-10-2]
- As of 2026-03-10, Tomasz Nowak is off the Team Dune on-call rotation. [valid 2026-03-10 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-03-10]
